career_ladder.note: Direct recruitment through the Sikkim Public Service Commission (SPSC) inducts officers as Sub-Inspectors of Police in the Sikkim Police, Government of Sikkim. Governed by statutory service rules and recruitment regulations notified under Notification No. 238/DIGP/PHQ/2025 dated 29.04.2025. Entry is at Pay Matrix Level 12 (₹37,500 entry basic pay under the Sikkim Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018; pre-revised PB-2 ₹9,300 - ₹34,800 + Grade Pay ₹3,800). Sub-Inspectors serve as investigating officers, border checkpoint commanders, and station house officers, advancing through the gazetted ranks of Sikkim Police and the Sikkim State Police Service (SSPS) up to Indian Police Service (IPS) induction.

exam_scheme.note: Governed by statutory recruitment rules notified vide Notification No. 238/DIGP/PHQ/2025 dated 29.04.2025 and SPSC Advertisement No. 14/SPSC/EXAM/2025 dated 20.05.2025. The selection process consists of three successive stages: Stage 1 Preliminary Examination (Objective Type Screening Test of 300 marks across 2 papers, each 2 hours duration; shortlists candidates at 12 to 15 times the vacancies for physical tests); Stage 2 Physical Measurement Test (PMT, qualifying) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET, 50 marks across 5 events: 100m run, 1500m run, high jump, long jump, shot-put); and Stage 3 Main Written Examination (500 marks across 3 papers: Paper I English 100 marks, Paper II General Studies I 200 marks, Paper III General Studies II 200 marks). Notice: Under the revised 2025 police recruitment framework, there is no viva-voce / interview stage; final merit is determined strictly on the aggregate of Stage 2 (PET 50 marks) and Stage 3 (Main Written 500 marks), totaling 550 marks.

financial_package.note: Sub-Inspectors of Police in Sikkim Police are appointed in Pay Matrix Level 12 with an entry basic pay of ₹37,500 (scale ₹37,500 - ₹88,500) under the Sikkim Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018 (corresponding to pre-revised PB-2 ₹9,300 - ₹34,800 + Grade Pay ₹3,800 under Sikkim ROP 2010). Note that under Government Notification No. 489/GEN/DOP dated 31.10.2011, direct recruits receive fixed stipendiary/basic pay during the initial training/probation period before standard allowances become fully operative.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 12 entry basic pay of ₹37,500 at project standard 58% Dearness Allowance (effective 1 Jul 2025; ₹21,750), plus House Rent Allowance (8% in Gangtok urban police stations = ₹3,000; 4% to 7% in other district outposts and border locations = ₹1,500 to ₹2,625), Uniform Maintenance & Kit Allowance (₹1,000 - ₹1,500/month), Special Hill / High-Altitude Compensatory Allowance (₹1,500 - ₹2,000/month for border and mountainous checkposts), and Medical Allowance (₹500/month). Net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic + DA = ₹5,925), Sikkim State Government Employees Group Insurance Scheme (SGEGIS, ₹300), and Professional Tax (₹200). Note that during initial basic training at the Police Training Centre under Notification No. 489/GEN/DOP dated 31.10.2011, recruits draw fixed stipendiary pay.
official_perks: Government designated police family housing quarters or barracks accommodation at district police stations or reserve lines
Official wireless-fitted patrol vehicle / motorcycle entitlement for operational investigation and beat patrolling duties
Uniform grant and monthly uniform kit maintenance allowance under Sikkim Police regulations
Special border area, high-altitude, and hazardous duty allowances when posted at Nathula, Kupup, or high-altitude checkposts
Comprehensive medical coverage under the Sikkim State Medical Attendance Rules for self and family dependents
Leave Travel Concession (LTC), Earned Leave encashment, and police welfare loan facilities
